name: Blanton Museum of Art
funding: Part of the University of Texas at Austin. Leadership Board chaired by Elle Moody. 2024-25 gifts of $100,000+ came from the Scurlock Foundation, Moody Foundation, Blanton family members and others.
watch: Scurlock Foundation money comes from Eddy Scurlock's oil fortune. Namesake Jack Blanton ran Scurlock Oil, and family members sit on the Leadership Board.
records_note: Its 2025 impact report names donors of $5,000 or more for 2024-25 and lists its leadership board; only an operating budget is given, no accounts.

name: The Contemporary Austin
funding: Expenses $10.3M (2024); trustees, members, Still Water Foundation, and Suzanne Deal Booth with FLAG Art Foundation for the prize.
watch: UNVERIFIED: Board read, no excluded name; sponsor list not reached. Site returns 403; archived support page has only placeholder text. No controversy found.
records_note: Its Form 990s for 2000 to 2024 are on ProPublica, its archived About page names 36 trustees, and event pages name sponsors; no annual report found.

name: BAMPFA
funding: UC Berkeley unit; top supporters (2026 list) are Mellon, Hewlett, Luce, Terra, Warhol, IMLS and NEH; U.S. Bank Foundation and Google among firms.
watch: UNVERIFIED: Supporters page not reached. Hollywood Foreign Press Association is on the list. A student labour demo at the 2016 opening targeted UC contractors, not a funder (article not opened).
records_note: A UC Berkeley unit with no reports of its own; the University of California posts financial reports 2015 to 2025, BAMPFA names funders undated.

name: Birmingham Museum of Art
funding: City-owned; endowment trust spent $1.3M (FY2025); top corporate circle is Alabama Power, PNC, Protective, Regions and EBSCO.
watch: UNVERIFIED: Alabama Power and Drummond coal sponsorship not checked. Alabama Power, a Founders Circle sponsor, runs coal plants including Miller, the largest US CO2 emitter as of 2021. Drummond is not on the list.
records_note: Annual reports with financial statements for selected years 2005-06 to 2023-24 on its site, an undated corporate sponsor list, and the 2026-27 board listed.

name: Boise Art Museum
funding: Expenses $1.7M (FY2026); E.A. Michelson Philanthropy, Steiner and Cunningham foundations, NEA and Idaho Commission on the Arts, with local firms.
watch: UNVERIFIED: Board not verified. Idaho Power, which sponsors the seniors programme, still owns a coal-plant share (13% coal in 2023). Odom Corporation is an alcohol distributor.
records_note: Annual reports 2011-12 to 2025-26 on its site carry a dated donor list and trustees; Form 990s 2012 to 2024 are on ProPublica.

name: Ackland Art Museum
funding: UNC unit, about 60k visitors a year; Ackland bequest, university, Mellon, Luce and Kenan Trust; Bank of America is the one corporate sponsor.
watch: UNVERIFIED: Advisory board page unavailable. A search summary said Ackland's fortune came from Isaac Franklin's slave trading. Not confirmed on any page opened.
records_note: A UNC unit: annual reports for fiscal 2023 to 2025 show a budget and donors; UNC posts the audited accounts, and advisory boards are listed.

name: Gibbes Museum of Art
funding: Carolina Art Association expenses $4.5M (2023); trustees, members, Art Bridges, SC Arts Commission, local banks and firms.
watch: UNVERIFIED: Site blocked. Roster unread: gibbesmuseum.org returns Cloudflare 403 and Wayback API was rate-limited (429).
records_note: One annual report (FY2025) with a donor list, Form 990s for FY2024 and FY2025 on its site, and the board members listed.

name: Orange County Museum of Art
funding: Expenses $13.8M (2024); Segerstrom real-estate family and private donors; now UC Irvine Langson OCMA, a UC unit.
watch: UNVERIFIED: Roster unverified. ocma.art now redirects to langson.uci.edu, whose support page lists no funders; Wayback was rate-limited (429).
records_note: No annual reports found; Form 990s for 2012 to 2023 sit on ProPublica, the UC Irvine site names no donors, and no board is listed.

name: Dallas Contemporary
funding: Expenses $2.2M (2024); Eugene McDermott Foundation (free admission), City of Dallas, McReynolds gala, Belmond, Highland Park Village.
watch: UNVERIFIED: Board names not captured. Labour row: two visitor-services staff were let go in March 2021 after urging an anti-Asian-hate statement. No funder controversy. See the Epstein cross-reference.
records_note: No annual reports found; Form 990s for 2011 to 2023 are on ProPublica, the Donate page names donors undated, and the 2026 board is listed.
other_findings: Epstein link · Jeffrey Epstein · documented: In 2014 executive director Peter Doroshenko asked Epstein to lend "Below", a Richard Phillips painting Epstein owned, for Phillips' solo show "Negation of the Universe". Epstein's assistant Lesley Groff replied that he was not interested, and the emails show no closer relationship. Doroshenko says he did not know who Epstein was.

name: Clyfford Still Museum
funding: Expenses $6.9M (FY2025); city-built, Still estate collection, foundation and members.
watch: Bloomberg Connects and The Anschutz Foundation (Philip Anschutz, oil and gas fortune) are listed as current supporters.
why_flagged: Bloomberg Connects and The Anschutz Foundation (Philip Anschutz, oil and gas fortune) are listed as current supporters.
records_note: It posts annual reports for 2011 to 2025 and its Form 990 on its site, shows partner logos with no date, and names its board.

name: Denver Art Museum
funding: Metro SCFD arts tax and the City of Denver. FY2025 gifts of $100,000+: Anschutz Foundation, Sarah Shaw Anschutz Foundation; Xcel Energy Foundation $25,000+. UMB Bank co-presented the 2026 Delight gala.
watch: Anschutz Exploration still drills for oil and gas; Sarah S. Anschutz chairs the board. Sponsor UMB Bank was campaigned against at Kemper in 2019.
records_note: Posts annual reports from 2002-03 to 2024-25 with donor names and a financial section, and names its trustees; Form 990s sit on ProPublica.

name: Nasher Museum of Art at Duke
funding: Part of Duke University. Founding gift from Raymond Nasher; a national Board of Advisors and a Friends Board guide fundraising; Annual Fund, endowment and exhibition gifts.
watch: The pin's tobacco-origin note is a historical link only. No current tobacco funder, objection or controversy at the museum turned up.
records_note: A Duke unit: annual reports 2006 to 2022 on its site, Duke posts audited statements, the Board of Advisors is listed, donor lists are old.
